name: Feishu Progress Card
description: Shows one updatable progress card per Feishu turn (tool steps, elapsed time) with a stop button, then collapses it to a one-line summary.

updateIntervalMs.description: Minimum gap between card updates. Default 5000.

showAfterMs.description: Show the card after this long even without a tool call. Default 10000.

maxSteps.description: How many recent tool steps the card lists. Default 8.

stopButtonTtlMs.description: How long the stop button stays valid. Default 6 hours.

titleModel.description: Model ref that writes the answer card's one-line result title, or "off" to use the answer's first sentence. Default openrouter/kaon/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Needs plugins.entries.feishu-progress.llm.allowModelOverride.

titleTimeoutMs.description: Give up on the title model after this long and fall back to the first sentence. Default 6000.
